figurative_meaning_en: daily routine worship of the chosen deity
example_sentences_in_bangla: সকালে ঠাকুরপূজা না করলে দিনটা শুরু হয় না।
বাড়িতে ঠাকুরপূজা করে পরিবারের সকলে প্রসাদ গ্রহণ করে।
example_sentences_in_english: The day doesn't start without Thakur puja in the morning.
The family performs Thakur puja at home and then partakes in prasad.
history: This term originates from Bengali Vaishnava traditions, referring to the worship of Krishna or other household deities as part of daily Hindu practices.
note: This is more of a religious term than a strictly figurative idiom, but commonly used in cultural contexts.
